UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5

svg.text: FLAT PATTERN 1:5 (coated side up = product side; dimensions on the neutral line, K 0.5)

g.text: Ø98.3 [3.870] (4 in tube ID) for ferrule item 6
cut AFTER forming (laser the pilot Ø20 only)

svg.text: CHECK TEMPLATE 1:10 (3 mm plate or 6 mm ply, cut from the DXF)
1. Blank: laser from 1524 x 3048 [60 x 120] 3 mm 316L 2B PVC-coated sheet; 1472.4 runs across the 1524 width, the 900 along the length. Remove burrs; keep the PVC on through forming.

2. Form the 884.4 [34.82] centre zone to R280 inside on plate rolls with pre-bent ends, OR by bump forming on the press brake: 74 hits at 12 [.47] pitch, 2.4° each, with a radius punch R≤ 100 and a 50 V-die. Leave
the two 294 [11.57] flats straight (no flat spot or kink at the bend lines).
3. Check with the template every 150 [6] along the length: gap ≤ 1 [.04]. Outside width at the top 566 +1/-0 before welding; spring back is taken out by the end plates.
4. Cut the 4 in port Ø98.3 after forming (pilot Ø20 in the blank), deburr inside to a sharp, clean edge for the ferrule weld.
5. Ends must be square to the axis within 0.5 [.02] across 566 so the shell seats flat on the end plates: trim after forming if needed.
blank, pilot Ø20, probe hole, 2 bend lines (layer BEND)
